description:
Marks an ongoing incident as resolved and updates root cause analysis details.

Use this tool when you have diagnosed an incident and want to close it, specifying what steps were taken to fix the issue.

id.description:
Purpose: The unique ID of the incident to resolve.

Accepted values: Integer ID.

root_cause.description:
Purpose: Explanation of root cause and resolution steps taken.

Example values:
Restarted nginx upstream service; 200 OK restored
Rolled back faulty deployment

name: resolve_incident
